detail.text: Check that a delivery note is present and that it refers to an open purchase order.

Compare the counted quantity with the quantity on the delivery note and on the purchase order.

The counted quantity is 99 and the purchase order quantity is 100, so the deviation is 1 unit. Under the stated tolerance, 2% of 100 is 2 units, and the smaller limit is 2 units; therefore the 1-unit deviation is within tolerance.
Post the counted quantity as counted with a note in the goods receipt.
Post the goods receipt in the WMS against the purchase order line.

Do not bypass a WMS error by posting against a different purchase order line.

detail.text: GR-512 means a goods receipt with the same delivery note number already exists, so stop and check the existing goods receipt with the shift lead before posting again.
Do not confirm the GR-512 warning without performing that check.
Because the WMS is showing an error code, follow GUIDE-WMS-003 for the code shown.
Do not work around the GR-512 error by posting the receipt against a different purchase order line.
Do not clear the error by making a manual posting.
Posting itself stays against the purchase order line; the receipt is posted only once the shift lead check of the existing goods receipt clears the duplicate warning.
Shift lead: responsible for checking the existing goods receipt when the GR-512 duplicate receipt warning is shown, before any reposting.
WMS key user: escalation applies if the WMS error is not solved by GUIDE-WMS-003; the matrix lists a one-hour response time.
